report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry is largely healthy: gateway error_rate 0.0014, p95 77ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, and order checkout spans OK. The only anomaly is order retained heap after GC (260MB, WARN x6), which is insufficient to establish a memory leak. Deployment record alone cannot prove latency causation. No taxonomy candidate is substantiated; hand off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service heap/GC time series over a longer window to distinguish a sustained leak from a short retained-heap increase
Order service memory limit and OOM/restart events to assess whether retained heap is impacting availability
Gateway-to-order latency breakdown to confirm whether the 995ms error span reflects downstream latency or a client-side timeout
Order service error logs or stack traces explaining the gateway ERROR status while order checkout spans report OK
